{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for email channel and completed status
email_completed = data[(data['channel'] == 'email') & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute average revenue
avg_revenue_email = email_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Confirm number of rows
n_orders = len(email_completed)

# Output
print(f"Number of email, completed orders: {n_orders}")
print(f"Average revenue: {avg_revenue_email:.2f} USD")"}
